method: Every figure is measured like-for-like from our price price snapshots of Bangladesh phone shops: official against official, import against import, one storage variant against the same variant, and a shop price comparison only across three or more distinct shops.

definitions.tracked: distinct handsets with at least one price ever recorded
definitions.snapshots: nights on which a price read succeeded and wrote rows
definitions.nights: calendar nights from `since` to `until` inclusive; `snapshots` below this means crawls that did not run or did not finish
definitions.in_stock: handsets a shop reports in stock today
definitions.listed: handsets any shop lists today, including delisted records still carrying stock

stories.headline: The Apple iPhone 18 Pro unofficial price is ==৳157,990 more== than it was a month ago
stories.caption:
Everyone tells you to wait, that phones only get cheaper. Here is what waiting a month did to the Apple iPhone 18 Pro's unofficial price.

৳10,000 on 11 September. ৳167,990 today. 42 phones we track cost more now than they did a month ago:

• Apple iPhone 18 Pro: ৳10,000 to ৳167,990 (+1580%, unofficial price)
• Apple iPhone Duo: ৳10,000 to ৳30,000 (+200%, unofficial price)
• Redmi Note 15 Pro Plus 5G: ৳45,999 to ৳56,499 (+23%, official price)
• Apple iPhone 17: ৳102,500 to ৳111,999 (+9%, unofficial price)

That is the cheapest listed price on that channel, read every day or two and plotted above. Full chart:

stories.headline: The same phone costs ==9.9% more== at GadgetAndGear than at the cheapest shop
stories.caption:
Same phone, same storage, same channel. What does each shop want for it on the same night? We ran that 156 times.

GadgetAndGear came out 9.9% above the cheapest shop on average. GaziElectronics came out 0.8%.

• GaziElectronics: +0.8% (34 comparisons)
• RioInternational: +1.1% (85 comparisons)
• SMSGadget: +3.5% (79 comparisons)
• Pickaboo: +7.6% (70 comparisons)
• AppleGadgets: +8.0% (65 comparisons)
• SumashTech: +9.5% (139 comparisons)
• Salextra: +9.9% (27 comparisons)
• GadgetAndGear: +9.9% (88 comparisons)

Shops bundle differently and stock different things, so a premium is not proof of anything by itself. But if you are about to spend six figures, the shop you walk into is worth knowing. Checked every day or two, every shop we track:
https://bhalophone.com

Which shop do you actually buy from?

stories.headline: Waiting 111 days on the Samsung Galaxy A33 5G saved you ==৳21,009==
stories.caption:
Somebody paid ৳49,999 for a Samsung Galaxy A33 5G back on 23 June. It is ৳28,990 today.

৳21,009, for waiting 111 days. The four phones we have watched fall hardest since the first night anyone here quoted a price:

• Samsung Galaxy A33 5G: ৳49,999 to ৳28,990, −-42% in 111 days (official price)
• Apple iPhone 17 Pro: ৳142,999 to ৳102,490, −-28% in 123 days (unofficial price)
• Apple iPhone 16 Plus: ৳184,999 to ৳135,000, −-27% in 123 days (official price)
• Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra: ৳245,999 to ৳179,999, −-27% in 100 days (official price)

Every line is one channel against itself, so a sold-out listing never reads as a price cut. Night-by-night history:
https://bhalophone.com/phone/samsung-galaxy-a33-5g

Anything you are holding out on? Name it and we will watch it.
